terms.comment: Our phrase, “all rights”, for when that is what the platform grants; full access may include further actions, depending on the platform. Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for full access on a computer; Morgan–Owens’s admissiō (s.v. access) is admission to a busy person.

sources: Lewis & Short: jus. Dictionary links support the component words; the modern technical expressions are labelled separately.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. available: access.
